echo "========== ITEM 1: PRODUCTION BASELINE FREEZE =========="
echo "Timestamp: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
echo ""

echo "--- GitHub HEAD ---"
GH_TOKEN=$(printenv GITHUB_TOKEN 2>/dev/null || printenv RORK_PUBLIC_GITHUB_TOKEN 2>/dev/null)
curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GH_TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
  "https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/commits/main" | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
sha=d['sha']
print(f'GitHub HEAD SHA: {sha}')
print(f'Commit message: {d[\"commit\"][\"message\"][:80]}')
print(f'Commit author: {d[\"commit\"][\"author\"][\"name\"]}')
print(f'Commit date: {d[\"commit\"][\"author\"][\"date\"]}')
" 2>&1

echo ""
echo "--- Render API /health ---"
curl -s --max-time 15 https://api.ivxholding.com/health | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
print(f'Render API SHA:   {d[\"commit\"]}')
print(f'Boot time:        {d[\"bootTime\"]}')
print(f'Status:           {d[\"status\"]}')
print(f'Environment:      {d.get(\"environment\",\"?\")}')
print(f'Version:          {d.get(\"version\",\"?\")}')
print(f'Render serviceId: {d.get(\"renderServiceId\",\"?\")}')
print(f'Routes:           {len(d.get(\"routes\",[]))}')
" 2>&1

echo ""
echo "--- Render API /version ---"
curl -s --max-time 15 https://api.ivxholding.com/version | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
print(f'/version SHA:     {d.get(\"commit\", d.get(\"sha\",\"?\"))}')
print(f'/version bootTime: {d.get(\"bootTime\",\"?\")}')
" 2>&1

echo ""
echo "--- Render Worker (if separate) ---"
curl -s --max-time 15 https://api.ivxholding.com/health | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
# Check if worker info is in health
worker = d.get('worker', d.get('workerHealth', {}))
if worker:
    print(f'Worker SHA:       {worker.get(\"commit\",\"?\")}')
    print(f'Worker status:    {worker.get(\"status\",\"?\")}')
else:
    print('Worker: bundled with API (single Render service, no separate worker)')
" 2>&1

echo ""
echo "--- APK metadata ---"
echo "APK version:      1.4.38"
echo "APK versionCode:  69"
echo "APK SHA-256:      a95fc34553306604c2a3be115a28c9b30e7627d2e9f9173888c9bdd5cf44ac08"
echo "APK size:         83,945,219 bytes (80MB)"

echo ""
echo "--- Parity check ---"
GITHUB_SHA=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GH_TOKEN" "https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/commits/main" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['sha'])" 2>/dev/null)
API_SHA=$(curl -s --max-time 15 https://api.ivxholding.com/health | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['commit'])" 2>/dev/null)
VERSION_SHA=$(curl -s --max-time 15 https://api.ivxholding.com/version | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('commit',d.get('sha','')))" 2>/dev/null)

echo "GitHub HEAD:      $GITHUB_SHA"
echo "Render API:       $API_SHA"
echo "/version:         $VERSION_SHA"

if [ "$GITHUB_SHA" = "$API_SHA" ] && [ "$API_SHA" = "$VERSION_SHA" ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "PARITY: ✅ PASS — All SHAs match"
else
    echo ""
    echo "PARITY: ❌ MISMATCH"
    if [ "$GITHUB_SHA" != "$API_SHA" ]; then
        echo "  GitHub != Render API"
    fi
    if [ "$API_SHA" != "$VERSION_SHA" ]; then
        echo "  Render API != /version"
    fi
fi

```typescript
export type RunStatus = 'ok' | 'failed' | 'timed_out' | 'completed_no_results';

/**
 * Classify a run's terminal status based on its data, not just the stored status field.
 * This corrects historical records where a Postgres statement timeout poisoned the
 * outer try/catch, marking a run as 'failed' even though real records were inserted.
 *
 * Classification rules:
 * - status === 'ok' + recordsInserted > 0 → 'completed'
 * - status === 'ok' + recordsInserted === 0 → 'completed_no_results'
 * - status === 'failed' + recordsInserted > 0 → 'timed_out' (real work was done)
 * - status === 'failed' + error includes 'timeout' → 'timed_out'
 * - status === 'failed' + no timeout → 'failed' (genuine failure)
 */
export function classifyRunStatus(run: { status: RunStatus; recordsInserted?: number; error?: string | null }): RunStatus {
  if (run.status === 'ok') {
    return (run.recordsInserted ?? 0) > 0 ? 'ok' : 'completed_no_results';
  }
  // status === 'failed'
  if ((run.recordsInserted ?? 0) > 0) {
    return 'timed_out';
  }
  const err = (run.error ?? '').toLowerCase();
  if (err.includes('timeout') || err.includes('canceling statement')) {
    return 'timed_out';
  }
  return 'failed';
}
```

```ts
async function runGithubCreateRelease(input: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const tag = readTrimmed(input.tag) || `v${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}`;
  const name = readTrimmed(input.name) || `IVX Holdings Android APK ${tag}`;
  const body = readTrimmed(input.body) || 'Production Android APK for IVX Holdings platform.';
  const apkUrl = readTrimmed(input.apkUrl);
  
  if (!apkUrl || !apkUrl.startsWith('http')) {
    throw new Error('A valid APK download URL is required for github_create_release.');
  }
  
  const repoInfo = getRepoInfo();
  const headers = await githubHeaders();
  
  // 1. Create the release
  const releaseResp = await fetchJson(
    `https://api.github.com/repos/${repoInfo.owner}/${repoInfo.repo}/releases`,
    {
      method: 'POST',
      headers,
      body: JSON.stringify({ tag_name: tag, name, body, draft: false, prerelease: false }),
    }
  );
  
  if (!releaseResp.ok) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Failed to create release', ... };
  }
  
  const release = readRecord(releaseResp.data);
  const releaseId = release.id;
  const uploadUrl = readTrimmed(release.upload_url).replace(/\{.*\}/, '');
  
  // 2. Download the APK
  const apkResp = await fetch(apkUrl, { redirect: 'follow' });
  if (!apkResp.ok) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Failed to download APK', ... };
  }
  const apkBuffer = await apkResp.arrayBuffer();
  
  // 3. Upload as release asset
  const assetResp = await fetch(
    `${uploadUrl}?name=app-release.apk&label=IVX+Holdings+Android+APK`,
    {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${await getGithubToken()}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/vnd.android.package-archive',
        'Content-Length': String(apkBuffer.byteLength),
      },
      body: apkBuffer,
    }
  );
  
  // 4. Return the permanent URL
  const asset = await assetResp.json();
  return {
    ok: true,
    releaseId,
    releaseUrl: release.html_url,
    assetUrl: asset.browser_download_url,
    ...
  };
}
```
